## 1.) kfold

## 2.) pre rec f1

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(e1071)

set.seed(1)
x <- matrix(rnorm(20 * 2), ncol = 2)
y <- c(rep(-1, 10), rep(1, 10))
x[y == 1, ] <- x[y == 1, ] + 1
plot(x, col = (3 - y))
###
dat <- data.frame(x = x, y = as.factor(y))

K=10
set.seed(123)
folds=sample(1:K,nrow(dat),replace=TRUE)

acc <- 1:K
pre <- 1:K
rec <- 1:K
f1 <- 1:K
tunecost <- 1:K
cost_tune <-  0.1^c(seq(-1, 1, by = 0.01))

results <- data.frame(
  cost = cost_tune,
  acc = NA,
  pre = NA,
  rec = NA,
  f1 = NA
)

for (s in 1:length(cost_tune)){
  for (i in 1:K){
    traindat <- folds!=i
    
    svmfit <- svm(y ~ ., data = dat[traindat,], kernel = "linear", 
                cost = cost_tune[s], scale = FALSE)
    
    ypred <- predict(svmfit, dat[-traindat,])
    mod_tab <- table(ypred, dat[-traindat,]$y)
    
    acc[i] <-  (mod_tab[1,1] + mod_tab[2,2])/((mod_tab[1,1] + mod_tab[2,2]) + (mod_tab[2,1] + mod_tab[1,2]))
    pre[i] <- mod_tab[2,2]/(mod_tab[2,2] + mod_tab[2,1])
    rec[i] <- mod_tab[2,2]/(mod_tab[2,2] + mod_tab[1,2])
    f1[i] <- 2*pre[i]*rec[i]/(pre[i] + rec[i])
  }
  results$acc[s] <- mean(acc)
  results$pre[s] <- mean(pre)
  results$rec[s] <- mean(rec)
  results$f1[s] <- mean(f1)
}
```

### CV 10-folds

### top10 f1-score

```{r}
results |> arrange(desc(f1), cost) |> head(10)
```

#### best cost ≈ 0.27 and 2 (same performance)

#### select cost ≈ 0.27 to avoid "overfit"

#### best_model :

```{r}
best_tune <- results |> arrange(desc(f1), cost) |> head(1)
best_tune |> select(cost)
best_tune |> 
  mutate(acc = paste0(round(acc * 100, 1), "%"),
  pre = paste0(round(pre * 100, 1), "%"),
  rec = paste0(round(rec * 100, 1), "%"),
  f1 = paste0(round(f1 * 100, 1), "%")) |>
    select(-cost)

```

ประสิทธิภาพ (10-Folds)

|           |         |
|-----------|---------|
| Accuracy  | = 93.7% |
| Precision | = 98.2% |
| Recall    | = 90%   |
| F1-Score  | = 93.8% |

### เลือก cost ≈ 0.27 และ run บน full College data ได้

```{r}
fin_mod <- svm(y ~., data = dat, kernel = "linear", cost = best_tune$cost)

summary(fin_mod)
plot(fin_mod, data = dat)
```

## 3.) Hw college grad rate class \>70 = high , \<=70 = Low

```{r}
library(dplyr)

college <- read.csv("College.csv")
college$label <- ifelse(college$Grad.Rate >70,"high","low")
college$label <- factor(college$label, levels = c("low","high"), labels = c(0, 1))
table(college$label)
str(college)
```

```{r}
K=10
set.seed(123)
folds=sample(1:K,nrow(dat),replace=TRUE)

acc <- 1:K
pre <- 1:K
rec <- 1:K
f1 <- 1:K
tunecost <-  0.1^c(seq(-1, 1, by = 0.01))
results <- data.frame(
  cost = cost_tune,
  acc = NA,
  pre = NA,
  rec = NA,
  f1 = NA
)

dat <- college |> select(-X, -Grad.Rate)

dat_mod <- svm(label~., data = dat)
table(predict(dat_mod), college$label)


for (s in 1:length(cost_tune)){
  for (i in 1:K){
    traindat <- folds!=i
    svmfit <- svm(label ~ ., 
                  data = dat[traindat,], 
                  kernel = "linear", 
                  cost = tunecost[s])
    
    ypred <- predict(svmfit, dat[-traindat,])
    mod_tab <- table(predict = ypred, truth = dat[-traindat,]$label)
    
    acc[i] <-  (mod_tab[1,1] + mod_tab[2,2])/((mod_tab[1,1] + mod_tab[2,2]) + (mod_tab[2,1] + mod_tab[1,2]))
    pre[i] <- mod_tab[2,2]/(mod_tab[2,2] + mod_tab[2,1])
    rec[i] <- mod_tab[2,2]/(mod_tab[2,2] + mod_tab[1,2])
    f1[i] <- 2*pre[i]*rec[i]/(pre[i] + rec[i])
  }
  results$acc[s] <- mean(acc)
  results$pre[s] <- mean(pre)
  results$rec[s] <- mean(rec)
  results$f1[s] <- mean(f1)
}


```

#### CV 10 folds

#### top10 f1-score

```{r}
results |> arrange(desc(f1), cost) |> head(10)
```

#### Best Cost ≈ 0.29

#### Best Model :

```{r}
college_best_tune <- results |> arrange(desc(f1), cost) |> head(1)
college_best_tune |> select(cost)
college_best_tune |> 
  mutate(acc = paste0(round(acc * 100, 1), "%"),
  pre = paste0(round(pre * 100, 1), "%"),
  rec = paste0(round(rec * 100, 1), "%"),
  f1 = paste0(round(f1 * 100, 1), "%")) |>
    select(-cost)

```

|           |         |
|-----------|---------|
| Accuracy  | = 77.7% |
| Precision | = 74.6% |
| Recall    | = 64.4% |
| F1-Score  | = 69.1% |

### เลือก cost ≈ 0.29 และ run บน full College data ได้

```{r}
fin_col_mod <- svm(label ~ ., 
                  data = dat, 
                  kernel = "linear", 
                  cost = college_best_tune |> pull(cost))

summary(fin_col_mod)
```
